title: Ukrainian lawmakers pass crypto tax and regulation bill expected to bring in $330 million

title: Crypto Long & Short: Bitcoin investors can’t keep ignoring Japan
content: Yen-funded carry trades ran an estimated $250 billion before the August 2024 selloff, and the Bank of Japan's policy rate is now around 1.25%. title: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb warns of phishing after deeper October breach probe

title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
